theorems.name: Submission.dsmc_em_cutoff_first_variation_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (H : Euclid P → Euclid P) (κ : ℝ) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ) (η : ℝ → ℝ), closedBall z r ⊆ U → AEMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → (∀ x, ‖H x‖ ≤ κ) → (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → tsupport X ⊆ ball z r → R.firstVariation X = -∫ x, inner ℝ (X x) (H x) ∂R.measure) → ContDiff ℝ 1 η → (∀ u, 0 ≤ η u) → (∀ u, deriv η u ≤ 0) → (∀ u, 1 ≤ u → η u = 0) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < r → (n : ℝ) * ∫ x, η (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) ∂R.measure + ∫ x, 2 * (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) * deriv η (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ κ * s * ∫ x, η (‖x - z‖ ^ 2 / s ^ 2) ∂R.measure
